name: A level 1 character can equip the starter Mining Pick and Blacksmith Hammer (#5220)
contract: Mining Pick 2901 and Blacksmith Hammer 5956 are vendor-bought starter profession tools with required level 1 in AzerothCore's item data. The imported world data replaced their stats with a placeholder artifact-quality row (quality 6, item level 10, required level 10), so a level 1 character could not equip them. Equipping each through the native handler at level 1 must succeed.

steps.label: Equip the Mining Pick at level 1
Equip the Blacksmith Hammer at level 1
The character still owns the Mining Pick
The character still owns the Blacksmith Hammer
